title: 第15章 修为大涨解封版第16章 神通种子的研究
content_zh:
;;
宝丹服下之后，敖鹏首先感觉自己就像是吞下一团火炭，灼热到他忍不住叫唤出声。
【你服用了虎骨壮魄丹，开始体质检测。】
【你通过了体质检测，药力开始发挥作用，体质+0.2，力量+0.1】
和第一次服用虎血酒一样，这药也能够直接增加属性点！
敖鹏自然痛并快乐地享受着。
本来迎人还准备应对敖鹏的小花样，但是看到敖鹏这么坦然就吃下自己给的药，她都怀疑是不是错怪了敖鹏。
只不过这个时候她也来不及多想，越到关键时刻，她自然越发小心。
连忙施展妙相，助敖鹏修行！
“你以拙火禅定之法控制那团火气，不要外泄。”
敖鹏连忙运转拙火禅定。
敖鹏整个人的皮肤就像是一只烧红的大虾一样，不停往外冒着热气，本来就已经极为强健的身躯，一根根血管突出，跳动，附在如同山石一般的肌肉上。
迎人知道自己这个时候必须出手了。
不然以敖鹏的修为，根本撑不住下一刻，那就真的前功尽弃了！
于是立马施法，要吸收敖鹏那拙火禅定产生的火气。
只是迎人不知道的是敖鹏身体特殊，一旦没有香火，身体瞬间就会由生转死，那原本灼灼燃烧的阳焰突然就像是失去了根一样，立马回缩！
你是红颜白骨，我踏马是真的死人，谁怕谁！
迎人正在施法的关键时刻，但是敖鹏的阳焰却是回缩，连带着她自身的阴气也一同倒转。
这就是敖鹏敢来红袖招勾栏听曲的原因。
如今他又得了黄帝素女经相助，这本来就是阐述阴阳至理的无上妙法，自身由生转死的瞬间，运转黄帝素女经的阴阳轮转之法。

迎人想要从敖鹏身上汲取多少火气，相应的自身就要被吸走多少阴气。
迎人施展的这般法术本来就是损人利己，就和诅咒之术一样，一旦被破，立马就有相同的反噬临身。
本来迎人都到了最后一步，大药即将唾手可得。
但反而是这番大药，成为了迎人功败垂成的一步。
她眼见大药即将炼成，但是忽然那大药如同冰消雪融一般消失。
不仅大药消失，连原本坚硬如热铁的敖鹏也变得冰冷，虽然依旧硬的如铁，但这种硬和那种硬是不一样的。
迎人就像是在修行一块钢铁一样，虽然在动，但是人怎么可能从钢铁身上修行到火气？
“不！你不能这样，那是我的拙火，我的！”
迎人厉声惊叫。
就像是欠了一百万，又被渣男抛弃的女鬼！
想起自己欠下的债务，她不能接受失败！
若是失败了，那悲惨得比做鬼还难受！
content_en:
;;
After taking the treasure pill, Ao Peng first felt like he had swallowed a ball of fire coals, which was so hot that he couldn't help but cry out.
[You took the Tiger Bone Strengthening Pill and started the physical fitness test. 】
[You passed the physical fitness test, the medicine begins to take effect, physical fitness +0.2, strength +0.1]
Just like taking Tiger Blood Wine for the first time, this medicine can also directly increase attribute points!
Ao Peng naturally felt pain and enjoyed it happily.
Originally, Yingren was prepared to deal with Ao Peng's little tricks, but when she saw Ao Peng taking the medicine she gave him so calmly, she wondered if she had wrongly blamed Ao Peng.
It's just that she didn't have time to think too much at this time. The closer the critical moment came, the more cautious she became.
Quickly use your wonderful skills to help Ao Peng practice!
"You use the method of Kundalini Fire Meditation to control the fire energy and don't let it leak out."
Ao Peng quickly activated the Kunluo Fire Meditation.
Ao Peng's skin was like a red-hot prawn, steaming out constantly. His already extremely strong body had blood vessels protruding and beating, attached to the muscles like rocks.
Yingren knew that he had to take action at this time.
Otherwise, with Ao Peng's cultivation, he would not be able to survive the next moment, and all his previous efforts would really be wasted!
So he immediately cast a spell to absorb the fire generated by Ao Peng's clumsy fire meditation.
What Yingren didn't know was that Ao Peng's body was special. Once there was no incense, his body would turn from life to death in an instant. The originally burning sun flame suddenly shrank back as if it had lost its roots!
You are a beauty with white bones, and I am a real dead person riding on a horse. Who is afraid of whom?
Yingren was at the critical moment of casting the spell, but Ao Peng's Yang flame retracted, along with her own Yin energy.
This is why Ao Peng dared to come to Hongxiu Zhaogoulan to listen to music.
Now he has the help of the Yellow Emperor Su Nu Sutra, which is originally the supreme method of explaining the principles of yin and yang. The moment he turns from life to death, he uses the yin and yang cycle of the Huang Di Su Nu Sutra.
As much fire Qi as Yingren wants to draw from Ao Peng, correspondingly, how much Yin Qi will be sucked out of himself.
The spell cast by Yingren is meant to benefit oneself at the expense of others. Just like the curse spell, once it is broken, there will be the same backlash immediately.
We have reached the last step of welcoming people, and the great medicine is about to be at our fingertips.
But instead, this great medicine became a step towards failure.
She saw that the great medicine was about to be made, but suddenly the great medicine disappeared like ice melting and snow melting.
Not only did the great medicine disappear, but Ao Peng, who was originally as hard as hot iron, became cold. Although it was still as hard as iron, this kind of hardness was different from that kind of hardness.
Welcoming people is like cultivating a piece of steel. Although it is moving, how can a person cultivate fire energy from the steel?
"No! You can't do this, that's my kundalini, mine!"
Yingren screamed sharply.
It's like a female ghost who owes a million and was abandoned by a scumbag!
Thinking of the debt she owed, she couldn't accept failure!
If it fails, it will be more miserable than being a ghost!
